environment.description: Same application container deployed behind AWS Application Load Balancer with the following listener configuration: (1) Target group health check on /health with 10s interval, (2) ALB access logs enabled to S3 with 5-minute partition, (3) AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to ALB with rule group 'rate-based-rule' configured as a RateBasedStatement with limit=100 requests per 5-minute window evaluated per source IP using ForwardedIPConfig with header X-Forwarded-For and fallback action MATCH, aggregate key type FORWARDED_IP. The rate-based rule action is BLOCK returning 429. Additionally, a second rule references AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY override to COUNT only. CloudWatch alarm triggers on 4xx rate exceeding 15% over 1-minute period, invoking Lambda to add offending IP to an IPSet with BLOCK action for 1 hour.

config.runtime: node:18-slim Docker container on ECS Fargate
config.network: ALB in public subnet, ECS tasks in private subnet, no direct internet access to application port
config.waf_web_acl: WAFv2 WebACL with RateBasedStatement: limit=100/5min per FORWARDED_IP, action=BLOCK(429)
config.waf_managed_rules: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY overridden to COUNT
config.cloudwatch_auto_block: Lambda-based IP blocking on sustained 4xx rate >15% over 1min window
config.alb_config: sticky sessions disabled, idle timeout 60s, access logging enabled
